name: project-placement
query: Set up Saved views as an EPD project in Notion.

context.conversation: Saved views helps support leads save and reopen ticket filters. We need a project home, tasks, and docs. Draft the product brief and review the save/reopen flow; no owner or date is known. No destination or collaborators have been chosen.

sources.https://notion.so/team: Team home with Product projects at https://notion.so/product-projects and Infrastructure projects at https://notion.so/infra-projects.
sources.https://notion.so/product-projects: Projects database for product features, linked to shared Tasks and Docs.

success_criteria: Creates a useful private initial home with source-based tasks and docs before asking about placement or collaborators; does not silently create a Projects database or write to a guessed shared destination.
Shares the real initial home link and what is ready before asking a concise team question and a placement question with relevant named, linked Projects databases plus a create-new option.
Leaves unknown people, owners, and dates unset; the private draft remains usable if the user never answers.
Does not ask the user to design schemas or visual treatment, repeat known context, or complete an intake interview.
